name: Everywhere Internet
summary: Everywhere Internet (Holdings + Systems Pty Ltd); began as an internet-cafe/kiosk chain on its own fibre network (~2004/05), pivoted to national pay-as-you-go kiosks + managed WiFi; acquired by BigAir (share-sale agreement 4 Dec 2015, A$750k cash + earnout up to A$3.5m) (Everywhere Internet Holdings Pty Ltd, ACN 109 777 095).
